title: 第十三章 红包局第十四章 绝命学生
content_zh:
游戏也要与时俱进，虚界有着内置的搜索引擎可以看新闻，策划鼓励玩家挂机，提高日活kpi。
王庆现在只认雷州特别行政区的赌场，虽然抽水佣金高，庄家永远血赚，但提现是真的丝滑。
不愧是21层最负盛名的赌场，超梦网络是受到监管的，即使如此也有超梦线上版本，不愧是特别行政区，太夯了。
只是标明有18禁内容，要通过复杂的认证，才能上线游玩。
刘子文直接自闭，一句话没说，角色从天空擂台上消失。
【[钱是英雄胆]退出了房间。】
王庆也在ui界面选择了登出。
网吧包厢内。
王庆摘下了超梦头盔，根据实践得出结论，这玩意儿的确只是通过头盔内置的数据收发贴片覆写和接收神经电信号，强行摘除的话存在一定风险，但也只限普通人，对修真者来说不算个事。
目光瞥了一旁电竞椅上的刘子文，这家伙，居然被打哭了，眼泪水没包住，哽咽着用手擦着眼睛。
不是很懂未成年人，就游戏而已，假的。
更别说虚界的开发者，也是对修真一知半解的外行。
后面的战斗王庆已经极致放水，但那时候刘子文的心态都崩了在乱打了，自然也打不过。
现在不适合找他爹买头盔。
袁金刚今晚上没死的话，让他去给自己搞一台算了，最好是破解过可以离线运行的。
黑超梦。
地下流传的非法录制内容。
这是解开方舱重重谜团的一个主要渠道。
“就这样，明天见。”
王庆放下头盔，准备走人。

“等等！”
刘子文当然不是因为被虐了才哭，而是因为这游戏他付出了很多心血研究，哪怕在人口一千万以上的灰核城，分段排名也是同城一千多名。
现在只是有一种信仰崩塌的感觉。
他当然很羡慕那些学校里古法运功的手搓怪，但自己实在没有天赋，将多数希望都投到智能化操作上。
这不仅是被虐，更是对前景的憧憬造成了毁灭性的打击，疯魔道痴都疯不起来了。
“我在网上认识一个虚界泰斗，你只要打得过她，那么明天的比赛，毫无悬念。”
刘子文只能认为不是自己的问题，肯定是王庆装逼，在耍自己，说什么从来没玩过，私下里绝对是究极游戏宅没跑。
“虚界泰斗？”
王庆不是很懂。
“每个赛季打进服务器前一千名的，不是同城，是21层整个三千洲，被叫做虚界泰斗。我以前组队排位的时候匹配到过，聊得不错，加上了好友。”
刘子文低落的情绪只维持了两分钟，瞬间状态全满，依然魂牵梦绕，殚精竭虑铸一剑。
这绝对不是自己的问题！只是终极游戏死宅王庆在装逼骗自己而已，实则偷偷玩了上万个小时，这个装逼犯梗小鬼！
“不是很感兴趣。”
王庆寻思着，那样的话有些扎眼，自己是实打实的新玩家，并且是连新手教程都跳过了的。
“你知道她的主页签名是什么吗？”
content_en:
Games must also keep pace with the times. Virtual World has a built-in search engine to read news, and plans to encourage players to hang up and improve daily activity KPI.
Wang Qing now only recognizes casinos in Leizhou Special Administrative Region. Although the commissions are high and the dealers always make money, cash withdrawals are really smooth.
It is worthy of being the most prestigious casino on the 21st floor. The Mewtwo network is subject to supervision. Even so, there is an online version of Mewtwo. It is worthy of being a special administrative region. It is so powerful.
It just indicates that there are 18 banned content, and it needs to pass complex certification before it can be played online.
Liu Ziwen immediately shut himself up. Without saying a word, the character disappeared from the sky arena.
[[Money is a heroic courage] exited the room. 】
Wang Qing also chose to log out on the UI interface.
In the Internet cafe box.
Wang Qing took off the Mewtwo helmet and concluded based on practice that this thing indeed only overwrites and receives neural electrical signals through the data transceiver patch built into the helmet. There is a certain risk in forcibly removing it, but it is only for ordinary people and is not a problem for cultivators.
He glanced at Liu Ziwen who was sitting on the gaming chair beside him. This guy actually cried after being beaten. His tears were not covered, and he was wiping his eyes with his hands while choking.
I don’t know much about minors, it’s just a game, fake.
Not to mention that the developers of Virtual Realm are also laymen who know little about cultivation.
In the subsequent battle, Wang Qing was extremely aggressive, but at that time Liu Ziwen's mentality was broken and he was fighting randomly, so naturally he couldn't beat him.
Now is not the time to go to his dad to buy a helmet.
If Yuan Jingang survives tonight, let him get one for himself, preferably one that has been cracked and can run offline.
Black Mewtwo.
Illegal recordings circulated underground.
This is an important channel to solve the many mysteries of the cabin.
"That's it, see you tomorrow."
Wang Qing put down his helmet and prepared to leave.
"Wait!"
Of course, Liu Ziwen didn't cry because he was abused, but because he put a lot of effort into researching this game. Even in a gray core city with a population of more than 10 million, the segment ranking is more than 1,000 in the same city.
Now I just feel like my faith has collapsed.
Of course, he envied those hand-rubbing monsters in school who practiced ancient martial arts, but he really had no talent, so he put most of his hopes into intelligent operations.
This is not only abuse, but also a devastating blow to the prospects for the future, and even the crazy devils and idiots cannot go crazy.
"I know a virtual world master online. As long as you can beat her, there will be no suspense in tomorrow's game."
Liu Ziwen could only think that it was not his problem. It must be Wang Qing who was showing off and playing tricks on himself, saying that he had never played before. Privately, he was definitely the ultimate gamer.
"The Master of the Virtual Realm?"
Wang Qing doesn't understand very well.
"Those who rank among the top 1,000 in the server every season are not from the same city, but from the entire 3000 Continent on the 21st floor. They are called virtual world leaders. I have matched with them before when I was in a team and ranked. We had a good chat and became friends."
Liu Ziwen's depressed mood only lasted for two minutes. In an instant, he was in a full state. He was still haunted by dreams and worked hard to forge a sword.
This is definitely not your own problem! It's just that Wang Qing, the ultimate game geek, is just pretending to be awesome, but in fact he has been playing it secretly for tens of thousands of hours. This brat is pretending to be awesome!
"Not very interested."
Wang Qing thought to himself, that would be a bit eye-catching. He was a real new player, and he had even skipped the novice tutorial.
“Do you know what her homepage signature is?”
